parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} handled by the outbound child SA.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} handled by the inbound child SA.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} handled by the outbound child SA.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} handled by the inbound child SA.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the outbound child SA due to any error. This can include compression errors or errors due to a lack of transmit buffers.

parameters.name: DecryptionErrors
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the inbound child SA due to decryption errors.

parameters.name: IntegrityErrors
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the inbound child SA due to integrity errors.

parameters.name: ReplayErrors
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the inbound child SA due to replay errors.

parameters.name: PolicyErrors
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the inbound child SA due to policy errors.

parameters.name: OtherReceiveErrors
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} discarded by the inbound child SA due to errors other than decryption, integrity, replay or policy errors. This can include decompression errors or errors due to a lack of receive buffers.

object.description: Statistics for this child Security Association (SA). The CPE MUST reset the child SA's Stats parameters (unless otherwise stated in individual object or parameter descriptions) whenever the parent {{object|#}} instance's Stats parameters are reset.
